name: The Lens
origin_lab: Voronova Xenobiological Research, a university-adjacent body-science institute with legitimate academic credentials and an illegitimate sub-basement. The project was funded under a biological process visualization grant — the stated purpose was to develop a model organism with full-transparency soft tissue to enable real-time in-vivo study of metabolic and digestive processes without surgical intervention. The grant body was told the subject scale would be approximately that of a laboratory rat.
origin_method: A large-format serpentine organism was engineered using a base of reticulated python skeletal and muscular architecture, modified with synthetic transparent polymer-analogue tissue in place of all soft matter — skin, musculature, organ walls, connective tissue — produced by a proprietary process that replaces the cellular components with a biologically functional optically-clear substitute. The skeleton was retained in its original calcium form and represents the only materially opaque structure in the organism. The digestive tract was designed to operate at full biological efficiency while remaining visually accessible from the exterior. At peak development the subject reached 11 meters in length and approximately 90 kilograms. The lab had intended to cap growth at 2 meters. The growth-ceiling gene failed to express. The organism escaped through a drainage access that was not rated for an 11-meter organism because nobody had anticipated needing to rate a drainage access for an 11-meter organism.
substrate: Engineered serpentine chimera, python base chassis. Fully biological. The body is composed of transparent polymer-analogue soft tissue over a calcium rib and vertebral skeleton. The organs are present and functioning and fully visible from the outside — the heart, the stomach, the intestinal tract, the liver — as if displayed in a specimen jar, but moving, processing, alive. There is no skin in any meaningful sense. There is a surface, and the surface is clear.
physical_description: In adequate light, and if you know what to look for, The Lens is visible as a slow-moving distortion — the same visual artifact as looking through a curved glass surface, a slight lens effect where its body crosses your line of sight. The ribcage is the primary visual anchor: the calcium ribs catch light differently than air and trace the body's sinuous form in a series of floating white-ivory arcs that appear to move through space without being attached to anything. When it is digesting, the contents of its stomach and intestinal tract are fully visible — a dark mass moving slowly through a glass tube that seems to float unsupported through the dark. At rest in darkness it is effectively invisible. Its full length, extended, covers approximately the length of a transit car. Its resting diameter, mid-body, is approximately 50 centimeters. The head is indistinguishable from the body except for the jaw structure, which is the only part of the skull that is structurally distinct. The eyes are transparent and therefore visible as two slightly clouded spheres that float, sometimes, at the forward end of the rib-line.
behavioral_profile: Slow, patient, and almost entirely silent. It hunts by constriction — it cannot be seen approaching in low light and the first indication of its presence is often pressure. It feeds infrequently; its metabolic rate is low and a single large meal sustains it for weeks. Between meals it moves through the large dark spaces of the GLMZ understructure with slow exploratory sweeps, apparently content to simply inhabit space. It is not aggressive toward things it is not hunting. It has moved past humans in maintenance corridors — confirmed by the survival of those humans and the security camera footage showing a floating ribcage drifting past an unaware technician at close range. It does not appear to regard humans as preferred prey. What it does regard as preferred prey is not precisely known, because the digestion process, while clearly visible, is advanced by the time any observer is close enough to see it and identification of the original material is difficult.
threat_level: High when hunting, low when not. The invisibility is the threat: standard environmental threat assessment fails entirely for an organism that contributes no visual, thermal, or sound signature in a passive state. It has a thermal signature only while actively digesting, when the metabolic heat of the digestive process creates a faint warmth detectable by sensitive instrumentation. Constriction force is proportional to python base architecture scaled to 90 kilograms — sufficient to be immediately fatal for a human. It is extremely unlikely to attack unless it has assessed a target as suitable prey. It is impossible to predict when that assessment will be made.
containment_status: Uncontained. Believed to range across a vertical span of approximately 20 sub-levels in the industrial and infrastructure core regions, following the large drainage and transit corridors that accommodate its length. No confirmed upper-tier sightings. No confirmed casualties directly attributed to it, though 6 disappearances in the deep infrastructure over the past 18 months are under investigation and two of those disappearances were in locations where a secondary review found ambiguous evidence of a large constricting organism.
known_locations: Primary drainage trunk, deep infrastructure levels 25 through 45
Old transit corridor D-7, which is wide enough to accommodate full extension
Sub-level 30 thermal processing chamber — believed to rest near the heat exchangers
contamination_risk: None biological. The polymer-analogue tissue does not shed or transmit. The risk is purely predatory and architectural: where it has forced transit through spaces not designed for its size, it has left structural damage that is subsequently attributed to settling or corrosion.
pacification_protocol: DPS Directive 5-C: Large Format Biological Hazard, Low Visual Profile. Engagement is substantially complicated by the target's near-total optical transparency in dark environments. Thermal detection is unreliable except during active digestion. Acoustic detection is the primary recommended method — the organism produces a faint low-frequency vibration through ground contact during movement, detectable with sensitive equipment. Heavy caliber rounds are effective against the skeletal structure. Note: multiple DPS personnel who have reviewed the camera footage have separately requested clarification on whether the floating ribcage they are looking at is actually a hazard or a trick of the lighting. It is not a trick of the lighting.
pitiable_qualities: It was made to be looked through. Every part of it was engineered to be a window rather than a body — to have no opacity, no privacy, no surface that isn't transparent to scrutiny. It has no way to be anything other than visible in the right light and invisible in the wrong light, and no way to be opaque, and no way to know that any of this is strange. It lives in the darkest parts of the city not because it is hiding but because in the dark its visibility problem resolves itself — in the dark, it is just a thing that exists, indistinguishable from the surrounding dark, which is as close as it can get to simply being unremarkable.
story_hooks: A maintenance worker has reported seeing, for three consecutive nights, what she describes as 'a ribcage floating down corridor 7 like it was out for a walk.' She filed the report because she is methodical. Nobody has followed up.

Something large went through a sealed section of the deep infrastructure and left a gap in a structural wall that wasn't there last inspection. The gap is 55 centimeters in diameter. It is perfectly round. The edges are smooth.

The Voronova researcher who designed it has been quietly trying to track it for two years. She is not trying to recapture it. She wants to know if it's healthy. She has a notebook full of translated digestion data from the camera footage, annotated with what she has been able to determine about its diet. She is, by any measure, worried about it.
